1.g3 e5 2.Nf3 e4 3.Ng1 Nf6 4.b4.strategy: Throws away a pawn: the pawn on b4 is undefended and ...Bxb4 simply takes it, leaving White a pawn down with undeveloped pieces while Black keeps its space in the centre.
1.g3 e5 2.Nf3 e4 3.Ng1 Nf6 4.b4.name: Hungarian Opening: Reversed Brooklyn Defence, Brooklyn Benko Gambit
